use_when: to show who is signed in, in the Sidebar and the Top Bar.
next to a name in lists, such as who logged a swap.
Use the Icon type when a person has no name yet, such as a new reader.

dont_use_when.when: as a button on its own without a name or tooltip.
Do not use more than two letters for initials.

best_practice: Use 32 in the Top Bar, 40 in the Sidebar and 48 in profile headers.
Write initials in capitals, such as SU.
Pair the avatar with the person's name whenever there is space.

variant_intent.size=32: Figma: use 32 in the Top Bar.
variant_intent.type=Icon: Figma: use the Icon type when a person has no name yet, such as a new reader.

a11y.fact: Without a label the avatar is hidden from assistive tech (aria-hidden).
With a label the avatar is announced as an image named by the label (role="img", aria-label).
